rule: Independently minimize field NRMSE of each method and seed over its entire saved trajectory. Report the actual accepted iteration and value at that minimum. Ties: first iteration, then first propagation. No averaging before selection.
scope: Retrospective truth-based best within the recorded run, not an automatic stopping rule or a proof of global optimality.
legacy: early_minima.csv preserves the previous mean-curve selection; superseded for the main report by per_run_best.csv.
